newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1996 exports up 0.4 pct - commerce ministry.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1996 exports up 0.4 pct - commerce ministry.

text.p: Thai exports rose 0.4 percent to 1.41 trillion baht ($54.23 billion) in 1996 against the earlier official estimate of 1.61 trillion baht for the year, The Thai commerce ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said Thai imports increased 3.9 percent to 1.83 trillion baht in 1996 from 1.76 trillion the previous year.
It said the trade deficit widened 17.8 percent to about 420.7 billion baht from 357.3 billion a year ago.
Exports of plastic products and footware led decliners, falling 58.1 percent and 37.6 percent respectively last year.
